meta.title: Adjust benchmark units to microseconds
meta.body_summary: Switch benchmark templates from milliseconds to microseconds, update runner to handle duration_us and display µs, regenerate benchmark outputs and markdown.

perf_labels.notes: Trivial unit-of-measurement change across benchmark tooling, self-merged by maintainer with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 506 changed lines across 63 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, but most churn is in auto-regenerated benchmark output files. The core change (runner.go, templates) is small, fitting a low-risk infrastructure tweak that was merged instantly.

review_details.concern_detail: No review comments; PR was self-merged by maintainer.
review_details.performance_claim: Switching benchmark output from milliseconds to microseconds provides finer granularity for microbenchmarks.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple config and unit change in benchmarking tooling; Agent successfully updated templates, runner, and regenerated outputs without human intervention.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body mentions 'make bench' as testing but no before/after timing data or output comparison; the changes appear to be automatically regenerated.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; merged without review.

core_change_summary.description: Adjusted benchmark templates and runner to output durations in microseconds instead of milliseconds; regenerated benchmark output files and updated BENCHMARK.md to reflect new units.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All benchmark output .out files and the summary markdown were regenerated with microsecond values.
change_trajectory: Single commit: 'chore(bench): measure durations in microseconds' updated runner.go to parse duration_us and changed template files to output µs; regenerated all benchmark outputs.

collaboration_trajectory: Maintainer (tamnd) self-merged the PR within seconds of creation; no external review or comments.
